reason: I pay about $15 per user now, so $199 for 15 users is roughly $13 each, which is barely cheaper. Moving my whole team and all our deals with no migration help is a lot of pain for that saving.
objection: The flat price only wins if my team is small. At 15+ people it is about the same as amoCRM, and there is no migration, so I would lose time and data for almost no saving.
would_change_my_mind: Free done-for-you migration from amoCRM plus a clearly lower total than my current bill at my real team size, with a proper trial on the Business plan.
